Hi Alex — thanks again for the time this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get a dedicated sizing session on the calendar.

Recap (from our discovery):
- Primary use: conversational customer support + post-call summarization for enterprise customers.
- Target model: Llama-family variant (preferred) and fallback to a 7B quantized variant for lower-cost tiers.
- Latency target: 95th percentile under 300ms for short interactions (~128 tokens).
- Expected concurrency: 40–60 concurrent sessions during peak (with 200–300 qps across endpoints).
- Typical seq lengths: user prompt + system tokens ~150–350 tokens; some long context up to ~2k tokens for transcripts.

What we need for the dedicated sizing call
- Confirm target P95 latency SLO and any hard max-latency ceilings.
- Peak concurrency vs sustained concurrency expectations.
- Any strict data residency/Private deployment needs.
- Example payloads (avg/95th token lengths) — you can attach logs or a few anonymized transcripts.

Proposed times for a 60-minute sizing + throughput deep-dive (PT):
- Thu Dec 3, 10:00–11:00 PT
- Thu Dec 3, 13:00–14:00 PT
- Fri Dec 4, 09:00–10:00 PT

I attached a short capacity calculator (lexicon_capacity_calculator_v2.xlsx) — if you can fill the highlighted fields before the call we can produce a preliminary pool recommendation during the meeting.

If none of those slots work, send a couple that do and I’ll loop in Ben (our SE) and Marissa (solutions lead) to join.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

Cheers,
